summary: CR-385 BUG-439 QA Round 1 re-test @1920x800 against /pms/front-desk-v2 on preprod. All 5 primary cases (B439-1..5) and both adjacent cases (ADJ-1 one-expansion-at-a-time, ADJ-2 keyboard nav) PASS. The Option-A fix (D73) is verified: with a row expanded, the drawer emits '-exp-' infixed testids (checkin-btn/kebab on Arrivals; bill-btn/hk-btn/extend-btn on Departures & In-House), while the row cell keeps its original testids. No duplicate data-testid values anywhere in the document across Arrivals/Departures/In-House expanded and collapsed states, and 0 duplicates when opening fd-room-tile-8525 on Rooms. Buttons in both row and drawer are disabled with title matching /Available in Phase \d/ and identical visible text (Check In, ⋮, Bill, Request HK, Extend). No visual regression on the Arrivals drawer (facts block + ✕ Close + bottom-right button row all present). Zero non-ignored console errors across the run.

cases_pass_fail.B439-2_departures_expanded (row 155): PASS - no duplicate testids; bill-btn/hk-btn/extend-btn each row=1 + exp-=1 inside expansion; disabled + Phase 4/3/3 tooltips; identical text 'Bill'/'Request HK'/'Extend'
cases_pass_fail.B439-3_inhouse_expanded (row 174): PASS - no duplicate testids; bill-btn/hk-btn/extend-btn each row=1 + exp-=1 inside expansion; disabled + Phase 4/3/3 tooltips
cases_pass_fail.B439-4_collapsed_all_tabs: PASS - arrivals/departures/inhouse each: 0 [data-testid*='-exp-'] elements and 0 duplicate testids
cases_pass_fail.B439-5_visual_no_regression_arrivals_dra: PASS - facts block contains 'Booking (incl. GST)', 'Paid so far', 'SGST', 'CGST', 'Balance due'; '✕ Close' present; bottom-right button row 'Check In' + '⋮' present and greyed; testids fd-row-*-total/-paid/-due/-close each =1
cases_pass_fail.B439-5_rooms_tile_8525_no_dupes: PASS - opening fd-room-tile-8525 detail yields 0 duplicate testids in the document (no Mark Clean / Request HK clicks performed)
cases_pass_fail.ADJ-1_one_expansion_at_a_time: PASS - clicking row A (15) then row B (17) on Arrivals leaves exactly 1 .fd-expansion element (fd-row-17-expansion)

critical_code_review_comments: Fix correctly implements Option A (D73): actions(r, variant) in ArrivalsPanel.jsx L41-46 and stayActions(r, variant) in DeparturesPanel.jsx L7-13 inject an '-exp-' infix ONLY when the drawer calls actions(row, 'exp-') via RowExpansionStub. Row-cell ids remain unchanged - fully backward compatible with any existing selectors.
No visual regression: same PhaseButton component used for both row and drawer buttons, so styling/disabled state/tooltip content is identical by construction.

Recommend adding a lightweight ESLint rule or a runtime dev-only assertion that scans document for duplicate data-testid values on route change - this would have caught BUG-439 during iteration 9 automatically.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 B439 cases + 2/2 ADJ cases + 0 console errors)

context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG-439 fix verified. Sandbox observed rows: Arrivals late chip has 10 rows (first tabIndex row id=15, second id=17); Departures today chip has 2 rows (first id=155); In-House 'All' chip has 2 rows (first id=174). fd-room-tile-8525 = r4 (2nd floor suite, currently Housekeeping). Duplicate-testid check must always be executed WITH a row expanded on each of Arrivals/Departures/In-House to catch drawer-vs-row collisions - collapsed-only checks will miss it. The '-exp-' infix convention should be preserved for any future action buttons added to the row cell + drawer.
rca of the issue: iteration_9 REG-1 duplicate: drawer rendered actions(r) with the SAME testids as the row cell. Fix (D73 Option A): actions(r, variant='') for row and actions(r, 'exp-') for drawer, giving 'fd-row-<id>-exp-checkin-btn' etc. Verified: 6 action testids in expanded state (3 row + 3 drawer for Dep/InHouse; 2 + 2 for Arrivals) all unique, and no other duplicate testids across the DOM in any tab/state tested.
